subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

CONSERVE
solution:
The correct answer is: destroy

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Conserve means to save or protect something.

 
 
• Example - *We need to **conserve **our natural resources.*
 
 
 
• *​*Marked option Destroy means to damage something so badly that it can no longer be used or no longer exists.
 
 
• Example - *The building was **destroyed **by fire.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Conserve' and 'Destroy' are opposite in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Maintain means keeping something in good condition by checking and repairing it regularly.
 
• Preserve means to keep something safe or in good condition.
 
• Support means the help and encouragement that you give to a person or thing.
